peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (14.5): 1.5 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 54 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 6). Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Tanjong Katong MRT about 90 m, Marine Parade MRT about 790 m; closer than 642 of 662 similar developments (the same as 5). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 730 m; more than 126 of 662 similar developments (the same as 165). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 590 m), more than 177 of 662 similar developments (the same as 29); nearest hawker centre Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre about 950 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area B about 190 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amber House, 31 new sales, about 380 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 660 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 780 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 820 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 840 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,320 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 1,330 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,570 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 314 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 471 new sales and 628 resales (1,099 purchases); new sales were 42.9% of these purchases. Subsales (39) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 628 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 192 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 628 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 719 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−12.7%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
